oe: abbr. （常印在账单上）遗漏不在此限（omissions excepted）；古英语（Old English）

a diphthong, employed in the Latin language, and thence in the
   English language, as the representative of the Greek diphthong oi. In
   many words in common use, e alone stands instead of /. Classicists
   prefer to write the diphthong oe separate in Latin words.
oed: n an unabridged dictionary constructed on historical principles
oedema:
n. 水肿, 浮肿
[医] 水肿
n swelling from excessive accumulation of watery fluid in cells, tissues, or serous cavities
oedipus: n. 俄狄浦斯(希腊神话人物)
n. (Greek mythology) a tragic king of Thebes who unknowingly killed his father Laius and married his mother Jocasta; the subject of the drama `Oedipus Rex' by Sophocles
oesophageal:
a. 食道
[医] 食管的
a. Same as Esophagus, Esophageal, etc.
oesophagitis: n inflammation of the esophagus; often caused by gastroesophageal reflux
oesophagus: n the passage between the pharynx and the stomach
oestrogen:
n. 雌激素
[化] 雌激素; 雌甾激素
n a general term for female steroid sex hormones that are secreted by the ovary and responsible for typical female sexual characteristics
oeuvre: n. the total output of a writer or artist (or a substantial part of it)
